title: `_host_re` should allow `_` as well
author: tlex
body_preview: In #3113 a new validator was introduced:  ```py _host_re = re.compile(     r"""     (         [a-z0-9.-]+  # domain or ipv4     |         \[[a-f0-9]*:[a-f0-9.:]+]  # ipv6     )     (?::[0-9]+)?  # optional port     """,     flags=re.ASCII | re.IGNORECASE | re.VERBOSE, ) ```  This validator however, breaks on FQDNs containing `_`, for example the docker swarm auto-generated `tasks.<stack>_<service>...

title: `get_host` should allow empty host
author: davidism
body_preview: #3113 updated `get_host` to always validate the host characters. However, it also disallowed the empty string. This is a bit too strict, it should only _validate_ the string if it's not empty, or if `trusted_hosts` is passed. And if it's not valid characters, it should return the empty string rather than failing.  This will match Django's behavior. I thought I had matched it before, as I referred...
